panels.caption: I_route = RMS of the saved 17-D QP nominal-to-selected command norm over the frozen window. The nominal diagnostic includes the original velocity-bound clipping; source vectors were not logged. Clearance covers continuum collision geoms versus this moved sphere, at independently saved 2 ms states. No full quality value is credited to failed/ineligible prefixes. A projected endpoint path is not whole-arm clearance. Qualifying preferred direction for this side: none established. Deployment: NOT_MET.
